_meta.description: Static-first visual design reference: palette, typography and layout archetypes with concrete values. Pick one archetype and commit before adding motion.

palette_archetypes.name: Deep Void
palette_archetypes.usage: AI research, premium SaaS, editorial presentations
palette_archetypes.avoid: Avoid for consumer brands, children's products, anything requiring warmth

palette_archetypes.name: Warm Cream
palette_archetypes.usage: Blogs, editorial sites, personal portfolios, coaching services
palette_archetypes.avoid: Tech products, developer tools, anything signaling precision or speed

palette_archetypes.name: Warm Beige (Smithery tone)
palette_archetypes.usage: AI tools, developer platforms, community products that want approachability
palette_archetypes.avoid: Copy the orange directly — it's Smithery-specific. Pick a new accent.

palette_archetypes.name: Cool Near-White
palette_archetypes.usage: Design tools, portfolios, agencies with Swiss/minimal sensibility
palette_archetypes.avoid: Contexts needing emotional warmth or brand differentiation from competitors

palette_archetypes.name: Warm Gray
palette_archetypes.usage: Interaction design portfolios, minimal personal sites, subtle brand presences
palette_archetypes.avoid: High-density or data-rich contexts — breathing room is mandatory

palette_archetypes.name: Soft Green / Organic
palette_archetypes.usage: Health, food, sustainability, wellness, premium packaged goods

palette_archetypes.name: Bold Black + Signal Accent
palette_archetypes.usage: Creative agencies, award sites, experimental portfolios, bold studios
palette_archetypes.avoid: Any signal accent must be used sparingly — one per page max. Don't pair two signal colors.

typography_archetypes.name: Thin Editorial Display
typography_archetypes.heading_font: DM Sans (weight 300) OR Neue Montreal (weight 200) OR GT Alpina
typography_archetypes.pairing_rule: Single weight family — distinction comes from size/case, not weight switches
typography_archetypes.usage: AI research, editorial presentations, premium SaaS, personal portfolios

typography_archetypes.name: Bold Grotesk Display
typography_archetypes.heading_font: GT Walsheim Pro OR Neue Montreal Bold OR NB International Pro
typography_archetypes.pairing_rule: Extreme weight contrast — hero at 700, body at 400, nothing in between
typography_archetypes.usage: Product launches, SaaS marketing, bold agency sites

typography_archetypes.name: Swiss Typographic
typography_archetypes.heading_font: Universal Sans OR Helvetica Neue OR Aktiv Grotesk
typography_archetypes.pairing_rule: Same typeface across all sizes — weight is the only variable. No decorative typefaces.

typography_archetypes.name: Serif + Sans Pairing
typography_archetypes.heading_font: Playfair Display OR GT Alpina OR Freight Display (serif)
typography_archetypes.body_font: Satoshi OR Inter OR DM Sans (sans)
typography_archetypes.pairing_rule: Serif for headings creates warmth; sans for body ensures readability. Never mix at same size.

typography_archetypes.name: Monospace Technical
typography_archetypes.heading_font: DM Mono OR Fira Code OR Berkeley Mono
typography_archetypes.pairing_rule: Mono for all headings and code; sans for body and labels. Tight line-height for mono, looser for sans.
typography_archetypes.usage: Developer tools, CLIs, API docs, technical portfolios

layout_archetypes.name: Bento Grid (Pixel-gap)
layout_archetypes.structure: CSS Grid 12-column with 1px gap; gap IS the border
layout_archetypes.css_snippet: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: var(--border); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden;
layout_archetypes.cell_background: Match --bg; creates illusion of framed panels
layout_archetypes.usage: Feature showcases, data dashboards, research presentations
layout_archetypes.collapse: Stack cells to 1-column at 768px; maintain border-radius

layout_archetypes.name: Editorial Single Column
layout_archetypes.collapse: Full-width with 1.5rem padding at mobile; font-size stays same

layout_archetypes.name: Asymmetric Split
layout_archetypes.structure: 2:1 or 3:1 column ratio — primary content + sidebar or callout
layout_archetypes.usage: Product pages, feature comparisons, research papers
layout_archetypes.collapse: Reverse to 1-column at 768px; sidebar content moves below

layout_archetypes.name: Full-Bleed Immersive
layout_archetypes.structure: 100vw sections, content positioned within; no max-width container
layout_archetypes.css_snippet: width: 100vw; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4rem;
layout_archetypes.usage: Creative studios, scroll-driven storytelling, product reveals
layout_archetypes.collapse: Keep full-bleed; adjust padding to 1.5rem at mobile

layout_archetypes.name: Masonry Image Grid
layout_archetypes.structure: CSS columns or JS Masonry; variable row heights
